_hinweis: Ein oder zwei kurze Saetze vor einem Event: warum Duc jetzt dort ist. Schluessel = Event-ID. Fehlt ein Satz, baut kern/ereignisse.py ihn aus der Tageszeit. Nicht fuer art handy und ort.

zeilen.t0_limousine: Today you join the Eden Rise in Antibes. The company has sent a car to bring you.
zeilen.t0_megan: You get out of the car and look for the person in charge. Someone is already coming.
zeilen.t0_holm: Before anything else, Megan wants you to meet the woman who runs this boat.
zeilen.t0_chiara: Megan has more people for you to meet, so you go back down with her.
zeilen.t0_rosi: Megan has a list, and the next name on it is the engineer. You follow her round the boat.
zeilen.t0_maxwell: Megan looks at her clipboard and walks on across the hangar. You follow her.
zeilen.t0_toto: Megan takes you over to the pallets, where the loading is going on.
zeilen.t0_lola: You smell something good from the far side of the hangar. Megan says it is time you met the person making it.
zeilen.t0_wahl: That is everyone Megan had to show you. You could still meet a few more people before you go aboard.
zeilen.t0_wahl2_jana: You say goodbye and walk back to Megan. There is still time to meet someone else.
zeilen.t0_wahl2_moore: You say goodbye and walk back to Megan. There is still time to meet someone else.
zeilen.t0_wahl2_siri: You say goodbye and walk back to Megan. There is still time to meet someone else.
zeilen.t0_wahl2_yamamoto: You say goodbye and walk back to Megan. There is still time to meet someone else.
zeilen.t0_lea: You asked to see the dive tanks, so Megan points you that way.
zeilen.t0_sophia: Lea goes back to her tanks, and her sister steps forward.
zeilen.t0_jana: You asked to meet the new deckhand, so Megan takes you to where she is working.
zeilen.t0_siri: You asked to meet the guests. Megan already looks tired, but she takes you to them.
zeilen.t0_yamamoto: You asked to meet the guest in the owner's suite. Megan tells you to be polite and takes you to him.
zeilen.t0_abschied_flirt: That is everyone. Megan has a flight of her own to catch, and you walk out with her.
zeilen.t0_abschied_foermlich: That is everyone. Megan has a flight of her own to catch, and you walk out with her.
zeilen.t0_abschied_frech: That is everyone. Megan has a flight of her own to catch, and you walk out with her.
zeilen.t0_abschied_herzlich: That is everyone. Megan has a flight of her own to catch, and you walk out with her.
zeilen.mx_tutorial: Someone is shouting “Number One” from the upper deck. Only one person calls you that, so you go up.
zeilen.g1_mina_post: You go down to the harbour for some air and some news from the village.
zeilen.g1_pascal_gebuehren: You have a small job on the quay and you only need five minutes. That is not how this village works.
zeilen.gv_casanova_megan: Somebody has let visitors aboard, and you are told to come to the main salon.
zeilen.g1_casanova_morgen: It is another bad night, and there is too much on your mind.
zeilen.g1_pascal_telefon: You have an errand in the village, and your way goes across the piazza.
zeilen.a2_morgen_gefeuert: You wake up, and for the first time there is no hearing to prepare for. You go down for breakfast.
zeilen.a2_morgen_kalt: You wake up, and for the first time there is no hearing to prepare for. You go down for breakfast.
zeilen.a2_morgen_warm: You wake up, and for the first time there is no hearing to prepare for. You go down for breakfast.
zeilen.rosi_werkstatt_offen: Word goes round the crew that you should go and look at the workshop.
zeilen.a2_unit01: The boat has gone quiet for the evening, and you stop to listen.
zeilen.a2_teil: Rosi sends for you, and she doesn't say why.
zeilen.a2_teil_maxwell: Maxwell sends for you, and he doesn't want the others to know.
zeilen.g1_batu_intro: Lola catches you on the quay. She needs fish sauce, and she says she knows a place.
zeilen.g1_batu_intro_allein: The galley is out of fish sauce, and there is nobody left to send. Somebody in the village has told you about a shop.
zeilen.g1_zg_zitronengras: You have run out of rice, so you go down to Bà Tư's shop.
zeilen.a2_vogelfoto: You have somewhere else to be, and your way goes across the aft deck.
zeilen.g1_sandru_logo: Mina comes past on her Vespa and shouts that you have to see this. She doesn't stop to say what.
zeilen.a2_toto_beichte: Totò stops you in the corridor and asks for a minute. He doesn't make a joke.
zeilen.lg_polaroid: You have been asleep for about an hour.
zeilen.a2_kevin_raub: Lea asks you to come down to the swim platform. She has something to show you.
zeilen.g1_batu_mutter: You need something from Bà Tư's shop, and it will only take a minute.
zeilen.g1_sandru_tafel: You stop at Alva's bar for a drink after work.
zeilen.a2_koordinaten: You have gone to your cabin to sleep.
zeilen.a2_koordinaten_ohne: You are lying awake in your cabin.
zeilen.a2_sonntag: Something is burning on the aft deck, but it smells good. You go up to see.
zeilen.g1_messe: The whole village will be there this morning, so you put on a clean shirt and go too.
zeilen.ol_wunsch: You have an hour free, so you stop at Alva's bar.
zeilen.ol_mantel: Sophia needs the right coat for her reading at Alva's bar. There is one man in the village who might know.
zeilen.ol_poker: You go looking for Yamamoto-san about the coat.
zeilen.ol_etikett: Danzel sends word that the coat is ready to be seen.
zeilen.ol_tuer_leer: Tonight is Sophia's reading. Alva asks you to come round to the back before it starts.
zeilen.ol_tuer_moore: Tonight is Sophia's reading. Alva asks you to come round to the back before it starts.
zeilen.ol_tuer_penrose: Tonight is Sophia's reading. Alva asks you to come round to the back before it starts.
zeilen.ol_echo: You go down to the mess for breakfast, still a little tired from last night.
zeilen.ol_dorf: You go up to the village for a few errands.
zeilen.rt_bibi_frischlinge_1: You take the path up to Mochi's to see how the animals are doing.
zeilen.rt_bibi_frischlinge_2: You take the path up to Mochi's to see how the animals are doing.
zeilen.rt_bibi_frischlinge_3: You take the path up to Mochi's to see how the animals are doing, and how Bibi is doing too.
zeilen.rt_charly_spiel_1: You hear shouting from the harbour, and it sounds happy. You go down to see what it is.
zeilen.rt_charly_spiel_2: You hear shouting from the harbour, and it sounds happy. You go down to see what it is.
zeilen.rt_charly_spiel_3: You hear shouting from the harbour, and it sounds happy. You go down to see what it is.
zeilen.rt_danzel_mass_1: Danzel sends word that he needs you at his new room on the piazza. He doesn't say why.
zeilen.rt_danzel_mass_2: Danzel sends word that he needs you at his new room on the piazza. He doesn't say why.
zeilen.rt_danzel_mass_3: Danzel sends word that he needs you at his new room on the piazza. He doesn't say why.
zeilen.rt_elsa_drei: Elsa leaves a message for you: come to the quay, it is official.
zeilen.rt_elsa_eine: Elsa leaves a message for you: come to the quay, it is official.
zeilen.rt_karte_bibi: You are hungry, so you go down to the mess before the day starts.
zeilen.rt_karte_charly: You go down to the mess for your first coffee of the day.
zeilen.rt_mochis_auf: A fisherman comes to find you and points up the hill. There is something above the bay that you should see.
zeilen.rt_mochis_auf_ohne: A fisherman comes to find you and points up the hill. There is something above the bay that you should see.
zeilen.rt_napf_erloest: You walk up to Mochi's before the day ends, to see how Bibi is doing.
zeilen.rt_napf_frei: You walk up to Mochi's before the day ends, to see how Bibi is doing.
zeilen.rt_pfote: You drop what you are doing and take the path up to Mochi's.
zeilen.rt_bon: Danzel sends word that you need to see something in his shop. He doesn't want to say it out loud.
zeilen.sn_apron: Danzel sends word that Bà Tư's order is finished. You go up to the piazza to see it.
zeilen.sn_cassock: Danzel sends word that the priest's order is finished. You go up to the piazza to see it.
zeilen.sn_coat: Danzel sends word that Elsa's coat is finished. You go up to the piazza, because you want to see her face.
zeilen.sn_dress_whites: Danzel sends word that Chiara's order is finished. You go up to the piazza to see it.
zeilen.sn_hat: Danzel sends word that the Mayor's hat is finished. You go up to the piazza, because nobody wants to miss that.
zeilen.sn_jumper: Danzel sends word that Petru's order is finished. You go up to the piazza to see it.
zeilen.sn_shirt: Danzel sends word that Sandru's order is finished. You go up to the piazza to see it.
zeilen.sn_strap: Danzel sends word that Mina's order is finished. You go up to the piazza to see it.
zeilen.sn_waistcoat: Danzel sends word that Totò's order is finished. You can hear Totò from the far end of the village.
zeilen.hb_zurueck: Someone shouts for all hands on deck. A boat is coming.
zeilen.hb_megan: You go up for a last look at the deck before you turn in.
zeilen.hb_koffer: You have been lying awake for an hour, and you give up.
zeilen.a2_steelmop: You hear your name in the corridor. Maxwell is looking for you, so you go down to the workshop to find out why.
zeilen.bl_manoever: Holm has called the whole village out for a practice. You walk up to the square with the crew.
zeilen.bl_alva_flinte: Word goes round the harbour that Alva has shut the bar. She never does that, so you go over.
zeilen.bl_elsa_hilfe: You are sitting down to dinner when someone calls you up to the aft deck. Somebody is coming aboard.
zeilen.bl_kriegsrat: Holm calls everyone to the crew mess for the war council. Nobody is late.
zeilen.bl_letzte_nacht: The meeting is over, but nobody goes to bed. You go up on deck to see who is still awake.
zeilen.bl_nacht_wahl_20: You go below to your cabin, and you stop in the corridor.
zeilen.bl_belagerung: You have checked the barricades on the square twice, and there is nothing left to check.
zeilen.bl_welle_2: The first fight is over, but nobody goes back to the boat. You stay with the others on the square.
zeilen.bl_abend_wahl_21: The radio has been quiet for an hour. Holm wants you in the mess.
zeilen.bl_nacht_wahl_21: The fighting has stopped for tonight. You go below, and you walk past your own cabin door.
zeilen.bl_echo_alva: You go down to the quay before the day starts, because you need a coffee.
zeilen.bl_echo_chiara: You go down to the mess for breakfast before Holm starts her list.
zeilen.bl_echo_lea: You go up to the foredeck for a minute of fresh air before the day starts.
zeilen.bl_echo_lola: You follow the smell of breakfast down to the galley.
zeilen.bl_echo_rosi: You need a tool from the workshop before the day starts.
zeilen.bl_echo_siri: You step out on the aft deck to see what the weather is doing.
zeilen.bl_echo_sophia: You go down to the mess for your first coffee of the day.
zeilen.bl_morgen_22: You have slept for two hours, and it will have to be enough. You go up to the square with the others.
zeilen.bl_flicken_22: There is a lot to repair before the next attack, so you go to find Petru.
zeilen.bl_welle_3: You are still working on the square when the wind changes.
zeilen.bl_welle_4: Nobody has told you to rest, so you stay on the square and wait with the others.
zeilen.bl_abend_wahl_22: A second day is over, and the radio is quiet. Holm wants you in the mess.
zeilen.bl_nacht_wahl_22: You go below again. You should sleep, but you stop in the corridor.
zeilen.bl_morgen_23: You wake up with your boots on. You go up to the square to hear what is left.
zeilen.bl_flicken_23: There is still a lot to repair, and you know where to find Petru.
zeilen.bl_welle_5: You go back to your place on the square. Nobody has to tell you now.
zeilen.bl_welle_6: It has gone quiet for the first time in three days. You come down from your place to the square.
zeilen.bl_bericht: It is over. You walk back to the square, because you don't know where else to go.
zeilen.rm_a1: You have stayed too long at Alva's bar again, and you don't mind.
zeilen.rm_a2: You go over to Alva's bar after closing, with one of Rosi's screwdrivers in your pocket.
zeilen.rm_a3: You wake up early, and you want a coffee that isn't from the boat.
zeilen.rm_a4: You go back to Alva's bar after closing. She told you to come, and she didn't say why.
zeilen.rm_c1: You can't sleep, and there is a light on up on the bridge.
zeilen.rm_c2: You go to your cabin early tonight.
zeilen.rm_c3: You leave the table before the others and go up on deck for some air.
zeilen.rm_c4: You can't sleep, so you go up to the bridge to see who has the watch.
zeilen.rm_i1: The sun is going down, and you go forward for some air.
zeilen.rm_i2: It is too warm below deck, so you go up to the foredeck.
zeilen.rm_i3: Siri has asked you to meet her on the solar deck, and she doesn't say why.
zeilen.rm_i4: Siri has asked you to come up to the foredeck when everyone else is asleep.

zeilen.rm_l2: Lea has asked to see you in the tender garage. She says it is important, and she says it twice.

zeilen.rm_l4: You go down to the swim platform, because that is where Lea goes when she can't sleep.
zeilen.rm_o1: You go down to the galley to find something to eat.
zeilen.rm_o2: You are still in your cabin, and you are in no hurry to get up.
zeilen.rm_o3: You can't sleep, so you go to the galley for a glass of water.
zeilen.rm_o4: Lola wants to show you something, and she won't say what. You follow her along the quay.
zeilen.rm_r1: You are getting ready for bed when you hear your phone.
zeilen.rm_r2: Rosi has challenged you to a race, and she doesn't take no for an answer. You go down to the generator room.
zeilen.rm_r3: You have a question for Rosi, so you go down to look for her.
zeilen.rm_r4: It has been a long, bad night out there. Rosi asked you to bring her the chips, so you go straight to the workshop.
zeilen.rm_s1: You go out on the aft deck for some air.
zeilen.rm_s2: You can't sleep, and neither can Sophia.
zeilen.rm_s3: You are in your cabin, and you are about to go to bed.
zeilen.rm_s4: You can't sleep, so you go back up on deck.

zeilen.br_lolas_notvorrat: Rosi asks for you in the galley. She says it can't wait until morning.
zeilen.g1_holm_kaffee: You go up to the bridge to report to the captain on your first full day.
zeilen.g1_chiara_tender: Chiara calls you down to the tender garage. She says there is something every new officer has to do.
zeilen.yk_vogel: You go down to the swim platform to see how the work is going.
zeilen.br_gaestekabinen: Chiara asks you to come to the main salon before you go to bed.
zeilen.g1_kevin_butter: You hear Lea's voice from the sun deck. She sounds very happy, and that is usually a problem.

zeilen.yk_schatten: You go up to the sun deck to get away from the crew for a minute.

zeilen.br_petrus_boot: Lea is looking for you all over the boat. She has news and she can't keep it in.
zeilen.br_yasins_angebot: Sophia asks you to come to the main salon. She says it is about money.
zeilen.fl_lea_salut: You go up on deck for some air before breakfast.
zeilen.fl_siri_blick: The sun is going down, so you go forward to watch it.
zeilen.g1_pfannkuchen: You go down to the mess for breakfast. You can smell it from the corridor.
zeilen.g1_unit01_klonk: You hear a loud bang, and then someone coughing in the galley. You go to look.
zeilen.auf_gitarre: The day is over and nobody wants to go to bed yet. You have an idea.
zeilen.br_dorfkinder: Lea finds you before you go to bed. She has something to show you, and she won't wait.
zeilen.br_elsas_kontrolle: Sophia asks you to come down to the mess. A message has come from the coast guard.
zeilen.br_fish_pie: Lola calls you into the galley. She wants you to settle something.
zeilen.br_jana_tender: Totò stops you on the stairs and asks you to come down to the tender garage.
zeilen.br_lola_flach: Chiara comes to find you with tomorrow's plan in her hand. She doesn't look happy.
zeilen.br_lola_krank: Chiara calls you to the galley. There is a problem with tomorrow's meals.
zeilen.br_nachtwache: Chiara calls you to the mess to sort out tonight's watch.
zeilen.br_nacktbaden: Sophia asks you to come down to the swim platform. She is trying very hard not to laugh.
zeilen.br_singen_ohne_strom: Lola catches you on your way past the aft deck. She has plans, and she wants you to say yes.
zeilen.br_siri_umzug: You hear voices in the crew corridor, and Sophia waves you over.
zeilen.br_siris_geburtstag: Lola pulls you into the galley and shuts the door. She has found something out.
zeilen.br_trinkgeld: Lea asks you to come to the mess. She wants your advice on something.
zeilen.du_harpune_chiara: Chiara calls you down to the swim platform. She looks far too pleased with herself.
zeilen.du_koch_lola: Lola sends for you, and she says it is about the galley.

zeilen.fl_alva_eis: It has been a hot day, and you need a cold drink. You go to Alva's bar.
zeilen.fl_chiara_kragen: You are late for breakfast, and you hurry along the crew corridor.
zeilen.fl_elsa_strafzettel: You have an errand on the quay.
zeilen.fl_jana_knoten: You go up to the foredeck to see how Jana is getting on with her work.
zeilen.fl_lea_neopren: Someone is calling your name from the swim platform. It sounds urgent, but with Lea it always does.
zeilen.fl_lola_bao: You have an hour free, and Lola said she would teach you something in the galley.
zeilen.fl_lola_mehl: You can't sleep, and the galley light is still on.
zeilen.fl_lola_sonnencreme: You have a few minutes off, so you go up to the sun deck.
zeilen.fl_rosi_bandana: Rosi calls you down to the generator room. She needs a second pair of hands.

zeilen.fl_sophia_blick: You stop on the aft deck for a drink before you go below.
zeilen.g1_chiara_inspektion: You go back to your cabin to get something. The door is already open.
